snippet.title: Mister Antonio - A puzzle game about a quirky cat with rather curious demands!
snippet.description:
Purchase on itch.io https://bartbonte.itch.io/mister-antonio?ac=qfCyYFQF-yt A puzzle game about a quirky cat with rather curious demands. Featuring surprising encounters, lovingly-crafted puzzles and satisfying sounds.

Navigate around the different worlds using the cursor keys or a game controller and fetch the right ball combinations for your cat in increasingly challenging levels.
